<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>F<SMALL>OR</SMALL> C<SMALL>LASS</SMALL> F, D, S&nbsp;&amp; I S<SMALL>HARES</SMALL> </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>S<SMALL>UBSCRIPTION</SMALL> A<SMALL>GREEMENT</SMALL> </B></P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">THE SHARES OF SLR SECURED SPECIALTY LENDING FUND HAVE NOT BEEN REGISTERED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT, OR
REGISTERED OR QUALIFIED UNDER THE SECURITIES LAWS OF ANY STATES OR OTHER JURISDICTIONS, AND ARE BEING OFFERED AND SOLD IN RELIANCE ON EXEMPTIONS FROM THE REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS OF THE SECURITIES ACT AND THE REGISTRATION AND QUALIFICATION
REQUIREMENTS OF SUCH LAWS. THE SHARES ARE SUBJECT TO RESTRICTIONS ON TRANSFERABILITY AND RESALE AND MAY NOT BE TRANSFERRED OR RESOLD EXCEPT AS PERMITTED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT AND SUCH LAWS PURSUANT TO REGISTRATION, QUALIFICATION OR EXEMPTION
THEREFROM. THE SHARES HAVE NOT BEEN APPROVED OR DISAPPROVED BY THE SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION OR BY ANY STATE OR OTHER SECURITIES COMMISSION OR OTHER REGULATORY AUTHORITY, NOR HAVE ANY OF THE FOREGOING AUTHORITIES PASSED UPON OR ENDORSED THE
MERITS OF THIS OFFERING OR THE ACCURACY OR ADEQUACY OF THE OFFERING MATERIALS, AND ANY REPRESENTATION TO THE CONTRARY IS UNLAWFUL. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SLR Secured
Specialty Lending Fund </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">500 Park Avenue, 3<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">rd</SUP> Floor </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">New York, NY 10022 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Ladies and Gentlemen: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Subscription Agreement (&#8220;<U>Subscription Agreement</U>&#8221;) is being executed and delivered in connection with the subscription
by the undersigned (the &#8220;<U>Subscriber</U>&#8221;) to purchase the number of shares of Class&nbsp;F Common Stock, par value $0.001 per share, Class&nbsp;D Common Stock, par value $0.001 per share, Class&nbsp;S Common Stock, par value $0.001
per share, and Class&nbsp;I Common Stock, par value $0.001 per share (collectively, the &#8220;<U>Shares</U>&#8221;), of SLR Secured Specialty Lending Fund, a Delaware statutory trust (the &#8220;<U>Company</U>&#8221;), through periodic calls of all
or a portion of capital amounts of the Subscriber&#8217;s aggregate capital commitment (the &#8220;<U>Capital Commitment</U>&#8221;) in the amounts set forth on the signature page below. Capitalized terms used herein shall have the same meanings
herein as defined in the Company&#8217;s Confidential Private Placement Memorandum, as amended, restated and/or supplemented (the &#8220;<U>Memorandum</U>&#8221;), unless otherwise defined herein. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In addition to completing and signing the signature page to this Subscription Agreement, each Subscriber must complete any necessary
attachments contained in this package (such attachments, together with the Subscription Agreement, the &#8220;<U>Subscription Documents</U>&#8221;) in the manner described below. This Subscription Agreement may be executed by hand or any electronic
signature service, and any such signature shall be treated as an original signature. For purposes of these Subscription Documents, the &#8220;<U>Subscriber</U>&#8221; is the person or entity for whose account the Shares will be purchased and that
can satisfy the representations and warranties set forth in the Subscription Documents. Another person or entity with investment authority may execute the Subscription Documents on behalf of the Subscriber, but should indicate the capacity in which
it is doing so and the name of the Subscriber. All appendices to this Subscription Agreement are incorporated by reference herein. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)
<U>Investor Questionnaire</U>. Complete <U>Appendix A</U> attached to this Subscription Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <U>Tax Forms</U>. Fill in and sign
and date the attached Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-9.</FONT> Each <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> investor is required to fill in and date the relevant Form(s) <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8</FONT> <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(W-8BEN,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8IMY,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8ECI</FONT> or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8EXP),</FONT> as applicable, in accordance with the instructions to such
Form. In the event that any applicable reduction or exemption from U.S. federal withholding tax is claimed, each Subscriber is required to provide all applicable attachments or addendums as required to claim such exemption or reduction. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <U>Evidence of Authorization</U>. Each Subscriber must provide satisfactory evidence of authorization and may be required to submit
further information for &#8220;know your customer&#8221; and anti-money laundering purposes. </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) For Corporations: certified documentation evidencing the corporation&#8217;s existence
and certified corporate resolutions authorizing the subscription and identifying the corporate officer empowered to sign the Subscription Documents. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) For Partnerships: certified documentation evidencing the partnership&#8217;s existence and a certified copy of the partnership agreement
(which, in the case of a limited partnership, identifies the general partner(s)). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) For Limited Liability Companies: certified
documentation evidencing the limited liability company&#8217;s existence and a certified copy of the limited liability operating agreement identifying the manager or managing member, as applicable, empowered to sign the Subscription Documents. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv) For Trusts: a copy of the trust agreement </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(v) For Employee Benefit Plans: Employee benefit plans must submit a certificate of an appropriate officer certifying that the subscription
has been authorized and identifying the individual empowered to sign the Subscription Documents. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) <U>Delivery of Subscription
Documents</U>. Completed and executed copies of the Subscription Agreement and all of the documents referred to in clauses (a)&nbsp;through (c) above, should be delivered to the Company at [&#9679;] or through secure file transfer. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) <U>Acceptance by the Company</U>. If the Company accepts the Subscriber&#8217;s subscription (in whole or in part), a fully executed set
of the Subscription Documents will be returned to the Subscriber. The Company may accept and countersign this Subscription Agreement (in whole or in part) at any time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Subscription</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)
The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees that this subscription (i)&nbsp;is irrevocable on the part of the Subscriber, (ii)&nbsp;is conditioned upon acceptance by the Company and (iii)&nbsp;may be accepted or rejected in whole or in part by the
Company in its sole discretion at any time. The Subscriber agrees to be bound by all the terms and provisions of this Subscription Agreement, the Memorandum, the Company&#8217;s bylaws, in the form attached hereto as <U>Appendix B</U> (as amended,
the &#8220;<U>Bylaws</U>&#8221;), the declaration of trust of the Company, in the form attached hereto as <U>Appendix C</U> (as amended, the &#8220;<U>Declaration of Trust</U>&#8221;), the Investment Advisory Agreement by and between SLR Secured
Lending Partners, LLC (the &#8220;<U>Adviser</U>&#8221;) and the Company, in the form attached hereto as <U>Appendix D</U> (as amended, the &#8220;<U>Advisory Agreement</U>&#8221;), and the Administration Agreement by and between the Company and SLR
Capital Management, LLC, the Company&#8217;s administrator (the &#8220;<U>Administrator</U>&#8221;), in the form attached hereto as <U>Appendix E</U> (as amended, the &#8220;<U>Administration Agreement</U>&#8221; and, together with the Memorandum,
the Bylaws, the Declaration of Trust and the Advisory Agreement, the &#8220;<U>Operative Documents</U>&#8221;) together with this Subscription Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) The Subscriber agrees to purchase Shares for an aggregate purchase price equal to its Capital Commitment, payable at such times and in
such amounts as required by the Company, under the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein. &#8220;<U>Initial Closing Date</U>&#8221; means the date on which Capital Commitments are first accepted by the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The Company has filed a registration statement on Form 10 (the &#8220;<U>Registration Statement</U>&#8221;) for the registration of its
common stock with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;<U>SEC</U>&#8221;) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Exchange Act</U>&#8221;). The Registration Statement is not the offering document
pursuant to which the Company is conducting this offering of securities. Accordingly, the Subscriber should rely exclusively on information contained in the Memorandum, together with reports the Company may file under the Exchange Act from time to
time, in making its investment decisions. The Company expects to enter into separate Subscription Agreements (the &#8220;<U>Other Subscription Agreements</U>&#8221; and, together with this Subscription Agreement, the &#8220;<U>Subscription
Agreements</U>&#8221;) with other investors (the &#8220;<U>Other Investors</U>,&#8221; and together with the Subscriber, the &#8220;<U>Investors</U>&#8221;), providing for the sale of Shares to the Other Investors. This Subscription Agreement and
the Other Subscription Agreements are separate agreements, and the sales of Shares to the undersigned and the Other Investors are to be separate sales. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">- 2 - </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Acceptance of Subscription; Closings</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Subscription Agreement is made subject to the following terms and conditions: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) The Company shall have the right to accept or reject the Subscriber&#8217;s subscription, in whole or in part, for any reason, including,
without limitation, (i)&nbsp;the inability of the Subscriber to meet the standards imposed by Regulation D promulgated by the Securities and Exchange Commission under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Securities Act</U>&#8221;),
(ii) the ineligibility of the Subscriber under applicable state or foreign securities laws or (iii)&nbsp;for any other reason. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) If the
Subscriber&#8217;s subscription is accepted in part and rejected in part, the Subscriber will be so notified and the Subscriber agrees to deliver promptly upon the Company&#8217;s request a new signature page to this Subscription Agreement with
respect to which the Subscriber&#8217;s Capital Commitment shall be such lesser amount as may be determined by the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) If the
Subscriber&#8217;s subscription is wholly rejected, the executed copies of this Subscription Agreement will be returned to the Subscriber. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) The closing of the subscription for the Shares by the Subscriber (the &#8220;<U>Closing</U>&#8221;) shall take place on the date that this
Subscription Agreement (having been executed and fully completed by the Subscriber) is accepted in whole or in part by the Company (such date being the date filled in by the Company on the signature page hereto). On the date of the receipt of the
Subscriber&#8217;s first Drawdown Purchase, assuming the Closing has taken place, the Subscriber shall be registered as a shareholder of the Company (a &#8220;<U>Shareholder</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) The Subscriber agrees to provide any information reasonably requested by the Company to verify the accuracy of the representations
contained herein, including the Investor Questionnaire attached hereto as Appendix A (the &#8220;<U>Investor Questionnaire</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) In the event that the Subscriber is permitted by the Company to make an additional capital commitment to purchase Shares on a date after
its initial subscription has been accepted, the Subscriber shall be required to enter into an addendum to this Subscription Agreement covering such additional capital commitment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. <U>Drawdowns</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)
Subject to Section&nbsp;3(d), the Subscriber agrees to purchase Shares for an aggregate purchase price equal to its Capital Commitment, payable at such times and in such amounts as required by the Company. Subscriber shall be required to fund a
capital contribution to purchase Shares (a &#8220;<U>Drawdown Purchase</U>&#8221;) each time the Company delivers a notice (the &#8220;<U>Drawdown Notice&#8221;)</U> to the Subscriber. Drawdown Notices shall be delivered at least ten calendar days
prior to the date on which payment will be due (each, a &#8220;<U>Drawdown Date</U>&#8221;) and shall set forth the amount, in U.S. dollars, of the aggregate purchase price (the &#8220;<U>Drawdown Purchase Price</U>&#8221;) to be paid by the
Subscriber to purchase Shares on such Drawdown Date. Each purchase of Shares pursuant to a Drawdown Notice will be made at a per Share price equal to the then-current NAV per Share. &#8220;<U>NAV per Share</U>&#8221; equals the most recent monthly
net asset value per Share, as determined by the board of trustees of the Company (the &#8220;<U>Board</U>&#8221;); <U>provided</U> that for any Drawdown Date that occurs prior to the determination of NAV per Share as of the end of the first month of
operation, the NAV per share shall be $25.00. However, the NAV Per Share shall be subject to adjustment to the extent required by Section&nbsp;23 under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;<U>1940 Act</U>&#8221;). No Investor
shall be required to invest more than the total amount of its Capital Commitment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Each Drawdown Purchase Price shall be payable, in
U.S. dollars and in immediately available funds per the wire transfer instructions set forth in such Drawdown Notice. In addition to the wire transfer instructions, each Drawdown Notice shall set forth (i)&nbsp;the Drawdown Date, (ii)&nbsp;the
aggregate amount of capital that is being drawn down from all Shareholders and (iii)&nbsp;the Subscriber&#8217;s share of capital drawn. The delivery of a Drawdown Notice to the Subscriber shall be the sole and exclusive condition to the
Subscriber&#8217;s irrevocable and unconditional obligation to pay such Drawdown Purchase Price in the amount set forth therein, without any right of offset, reduction, counterclaim or defense. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">- 3 - </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) Concurrent with any payment of all or a portion of the Drawdown Purchase Price, the
Company shall issue to the Subscriber a number of Shares equal to the amount of the Drawdown Purchase Price funded by the Subscriber on the applicable Drawdown Date divided by the NAV per Share as of such Drawdown Date. For the avoidance of doubt,
the Company shall not issue Shares for any portion of the Subscriber&#8217;s Capital Commitment that has not been paid to the Company and used to purchase Shares pursuant to one or more Drawdown Notices (the &#8220;<U>Undrawn Capital
Commitment</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) Except as set forth below, the Subscriber shall be released from any obligation to fund any portion of its
Capital Commitment for which it has not received a Drawdown Notice prior to the termination of the &#8220;<U>Investment Period</U>,&#8221; which is defined as the period beginning on the Initial Closing Date and ending on the eighth anniversary of
the Initial Closing Date, provided that, (i)&nbsp;upon the approval of the Board, the Investment Period can be extended for up to two additional <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-year</FONT> periods and (ii)&nbsp;upon request of the Board and the
approval of the shareholders of the Company, the Investment Period can be further extended, and, provided, further, that, the Board can terminate the Investment Period at any time in its discretion if it determines that such termination is
consistent with the Board&#8217;s exercise of its duties to the Company (subject to any necessary approvals and applicable requirements of the 1940 Act). After termination of the Investment Period, the Subscriber shall be released from any
obligation to fund any portion of its Capital Commitment for which it has not received a Drawdown Notice, except to the extent necessary to (A)&nbsp;pay expenses of the Company, including management fees, amounts due or that may become due under any
financing or similar obligations, and indemnity obligations, (B)&nbsp;fund investments or obligations (including guarantees) of the Company in connection with any transaction for which there is a binding written agreement as of the end of the
Investment Period (including phased investments), or (C)&nbsp;make protective advances and investments related to restructurings and similar transactions involving an existing investment. The Subscriber acknowledges that, at any time, the Board can
seek shareholder approval of a &#8220;<U>Liquidity Event</U>,&#8221; which is defined as any of the following: (1)&nbsp;an initial public offering of the Shares (&#8220;<U>IPO</U>&#8221;) or a listing of the Shares on a national securities exchange
(&#8220;<U>listing</U>&#8221;) or (2)&nbsp;a transaction pursuant to which the Company would (a)&nbsp;sell all or substantially all of its assets or (b)&nbsp;engage in a merger, consolidation or statutory share exchange with one or more entities in
which all or substantially all of the Shares then outstanding are converted into cash or securities of another entity. Potential acquirers could include other business development companies (&#8220;<U>BDCs</U>&#8221;) and entities that are not BDCs,
in each case, that are advised by the Adviser or its affiliates or by unaffiliated third parties. However, any Liquidity Event must (a)&nbsp;be approved by the affirmative vote of holders of shares entitled to cast a majority of all the votes
entitled to be cast on the matter and (b)&nbsp;give shareholders the option to receive consideration, in the form of cash, in an amount per share that is not less than the net asset value per share as of the closing of the Liquidity Event.
Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Subscriber shall be released from any obligation to make any Drawdown Purchases upon the closing of any Liquidity Event. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees that the Company intends to request contributions from all Investors with an Undrawn Capital
Commitment pro rata in accordance with the Capital Commitments of all investors with Undrawn Capital Commitments; <U>provided</U> that the Company shall retain the right, if determined by the Company in its sole discretion, to require the Subscriber
(i)&nbsp;to fund a Drawdown Purchase Price that is more or less than its pro rata share or (ii)&nbsp;to fund a Drawdown Purchase Price (but not require Other Investors to do so), in either case, in order to accelerate the fulfillment of the
Subscriber&#8217;s Capital Commitment if less than 20% of the Subscriber&#8217;s Capital Commitment remains undrawn, to seek to equalize the percentage of the Subscriber&#8217;s total Capital Commitment that has been contributed to the Company
relative to the capital contributions of Other Investors, or to avoid any of the Default Remedy Limitations (as defined below) or for other regulatory reasons. The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees that the Company may, if determined by the Company
in its sole discretion, from time to time require capital contributions from Other Investors and not the Subscriber. Accordingly, Drawdown Notices may be issued only to selected investors and Shareholders (including or excluding the Subscriber) from
time to time and require a purchase of Shares by such investors in amounts determined by the Company in its sole discretion. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.
<U>Pledging</U>. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the Subscriber specifically agrees and consents that the Company may, at any time, without further notice to or consent from the Subscriber (except to the extent otherwise provided
in this Subscription Agreement), grant security over and, in connection therewith, transfer its right to draw down capital from the Subscriber pursuant to Section&nbsp;3, and the Company&#8217;s right to receive the Drawdown Purchase Price (and any
related rights of the Company), to lenders or other creditors of the Company, in connection with any indebtedness, guarantee or surety of the Company; <U>provided</U> that, for the avoidance of doubt, any such grantee&#8217;s right to draw down
capital shall be subject to the limitations on the Company&#8217;s right to draw down capital pursuant to Section&nbsp;3. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">- 4 - </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. <U>Dividends; Dividend Reinvestment Plan</U>. As described more fully in the Memorandum,
the Company generally intends to distribute on a quarterly basis, out of assets legally available for distribution, substantially all of its available earnings in such amount so the Company will not have to pay corporate-level income tax, subject to
the discretion of the Board. The Company has adopted a dividend reinvestment plan (as in effect from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Dividend Reinvestment Plan</U>&#8221;), pursuant to which the Company shall reinvest all cash distributions declared by
the Board on behalf of any Shareholder, other than any Shareholder that has affirmatively elected to opt out of the Dividend Reinvestment Plan, in exchange for such Shareholder receiving a number of newly issued Shares equal to the quotient
determined by dividing the amount of cash otherwise to be distributed to such Shareholder in connection with such distribution by the NAV per Share as of the valuation date fixed by the Board for such distribution. The Subscriber may opt out of the
Dividend Reinvestment Plan in the Investor Questionnaire, in which case the Subscriber will receive cash distributions. An election to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">opt-out</FONT> or to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">opt-in</FONT> to the
Dividend Reinvestment Plan may be altered, subject to approval by the Company, by notifying the Company in writing at 500 Park Avenue, 3<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">rd</SUP> Floor, New York, NY 10022, Attention: Investor Relations.
A change in election must be received by the Company at least ten calendar days prior to any distribution date; otherwise, such election shall be effective only with respect to any subsequent distributions. The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees
that any distributions received by the Subscriber or reinvested by the Company on the Subscriber&#8217;s behalf pursuant to the Dividend Reinvestment Plan shall have no effect on the amount of the Subscriber&#8217;s Undrawn Capital Commitment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6. <U>Remedies Upon Drawdown Purchase Price Default</U>. In the event that the Subscriber fails to pay all or any portion of the Drawdown
Purchase Price due from the Subscriber on any Drawdown Date (such amount, together with the amount of the Subscriber&#8217;s Undrawn Capital Commitment, a &#8220;<U>Defaulted Commitment</U>&#8221;) and such default remains uncured for a period of
ten days, then the Company shall be permitted to declare the Subscriber to be in default on its obligations under this Subscription Agreement (in such capacity, a &#8220;<U>Defaulting Investor</U>&#8221; and, collectively with any Other Investors
declared to be in default, the &#8220;<U>Defaulting Shareholders</U>&#8221;) and shall be permitted to pursue one or any combination of the following remedies: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <I>Participation in Future Drawdowns</I>. The Company may prohibit the Defaulting Investor from purchasing additional Shares on any future
Drawdown Date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <I>Forfeiture of Shares</I>. <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">One-third</FONT> of the Shares then held by the
Defaulting Investor may be automatically forfeited and transferred on the books of the Company to the Other Investors (other than any other Defaulting Shareholders), <I>pro rata</I> in accordance with their respective number of Shares held;
<U>provided</U> that no Shares shall be transferred to any Other Investor pursuant to this Section&nbsp;6(b) in the event that such transfer would (i)&nbsp;violate the Securities Act, the 1940 Act or any state (or other jurisdiction) securities or
&#8220;blue sky&#8221; laws applicable to the Company or such transfer, (ii)&nbsp;constitute a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-exempt</FONT> &#8220;prohibited transaction&#8221; under Section&nbsp;406 of the Employee Retirement Income Security
Act of 1974, as amended (&#8220;<U>ERISA</U>&#8221;), or Section&nbsp;4975 of the U.S. Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Code</U>&#8221;), or (iii)&nbsp;cause all or any portion of the assets of the Company to constitute
&#8220;plan assets&#8221; under ERISA or Section&nbsp;4975 of the Code (the &#8220;<U>Default Remedy Limitations</U>&#8221;) (it being understood that this proviso shall operate only to the extent necessary to avoid the occurrence of the
consequences contemplated herein and shall not prevent any Other Investor from receiving a partial allocation of its pro rata portion of Shares); and <U>provided</U>, <U>further</U>, that any Shares that have not been transferred to one or more
Other Investors pursuant to the previous proviso shall be allocated among the participating Other Investors pro rata in accordance with their respective number of Shares held. The mechanism described in this Section&nbsp;6(b) is intended to operate
as a liquidated damage provision since the damage to the Company and the Other Investors resulting from a default by the Defaulting Investor is both significant and not easily susceptible to precise quantification. By entry into this Subscription
Agreement, the Subscriber agrees to this Section&nbsp;6(b) and acknowledges that the automatic transfer of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-third</FONT> of its Shares constitutes a reasonable liquidated damages remedy for any default of the
Subscriber&#8217;s obligations to fund a Drawdown Purchase Price. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <I>Inability to Vote</I>. To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the
Defaulting Investor hereby makes, constitutes and appoints the Company with full power of substitution, its true and lawful proxy to exercise all voting and other rights of such Defaulting Investor with respect to the Shares, at every annual,
special or adjourned meeting of the shareholders of the Company and in every written consent in lieu of such meeting in exact proportion to the votes or consents cast by Shareholders other than Defaulting Shareholders or, in the absence of any such

Section&nbsp;14. It is the Subscriber&#8217;s responsibility to ensure that the Address of the Subscriber set forth on the signature page hereto and in the books and records of the Company is current, true, accurate, and complete. Notices shall be
deemed to have been given (i)&nbsp;when personally delivered, (ii)&nbsp;if sent by registered or certified mail, three days after the date on which deposited in the mails, (iii)&nbsp;if sent by a reputable overnight courier service, on the second
business day after transmittal thereof to such courier service, (iv)&nbsp;if sent by Electronic Transmission, on the date sent, or (v)&nbsp;in any event and notwithstanding any provision of this Section&nbsp;14 to the contrary, no later than when
actually received, provided that notices of a change of Address shall not be deemed given until the actual receipt thereof. Notwithstanding any provision hereof to the contrary, any Notice may be given by posting such Notice to, or making such
Notice otherwise available from, any Web portal or other electronic network established or maintained by or for the benefit of the Company, the Adviser, or any affiliate thereof, together with written notice given in any manner authorized by this
Subscription Agreement (other than this sentence) to the effect that such Notice has been so posted or is otherwise so available, in which case such Notice shall be deemed to have been given on the later of (x)&nbsp;the date that such Notice is
posted to, or otherwise accessible from, such Web portal or other electronic network and (y)&nbsp;the date that such notice of posting or availability is deemed given hereunder. The provisions of this Section&nbsp;14 shall not prohibit the giving of
written notice in any other manner; any such written notice shall be deemed given only when actually received. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">- 14 - </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
&#8220;<U>Electronic Transmission</U>&#8221; means any form of communication, not directly involving the physical transmission of paper, that creates a record that may be retained, retrieved, and
reviewed by the recipient thereof, and that may be printed or reproduced in paper form by such recipient through an automated process, including without limitation facsimile transmission, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> communication,
and a .pdf file attached to an <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> communication. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) If the Subscriber is a participant in
any investment vehicle (other than the Company) or account established, sponsored, or managed by SLR Capital Partners, LLC or any affiliate thereof (each, an &#8220;<U>SLR Product</U>&#8221;), then the Subscriber agrees that all notices, demands,
solicitations of consent or approval, statements, tax documents, reports, and other communications under the constitutive documents of or in connection with such SLR Product (each, a &#8220;<U>SLR Notice</U>&#8221;) may be given in the same manner
as any Notices as set forth in Section&nbsp;14(a), even though the Subscriber may currently receive such SLR Notices in a different manner. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The Subscriber hereby agrees to enter into any commercially reasonable end user license agreement required of users of any Web portal or
other electronic network established, maintained, or made available by or for the benefit of the Company, the Adviser, or any affiliate thereof pursuant to which Notices or SLR Notices are or will be delivered. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">15. <U>Power of Attorney</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">By executing this Subscription Agreement the Subscriber hereby makes, constitutes and appoints the Company with full power of substitution,
its true and lawful <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">attorney-in-fact,</FONT></FONT> in its name, place and stead for its use and benefit, to approve, execute, acknowledge, swear to, file and record: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) any and all filings required to be made by the Subscriber under the Exchange Act with respect to any of the Company&#8217;s securities
that may be deemed to be beneficially owned by the Subscriber under the Exchange Act; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) all certificates and other instruments deemed
advisable by the Company in order for the Company to enter into any borrowing or other financing arrangement and to grant any pledge or other security interest, including over the Subscriber&#8217;s Capital Commitment or Shares, in connection
therewith; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) all certificates and other instruments deemed advisable by the Company to comply with the provisions of this Subscription
Agreement and applicable law or regulation to permit the Company to become or to continue as a BDC; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) all conveyances and other
instruments necessary or appropriate to effect the dissolution and liquidation of the Company; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) all other instruments or papers not
inconsistent with the terms of this Subscription Agreement that may be required by law to be filed on behalf of the Company; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) any
amendment or modification to any of the foregoing and all other certificates, instruments and documents which said <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">attorney-in-fact</FONT></FONT> determines in its sole discretion are
necessary or desirable to effectuate the provisions of this Subscription Agreement or any Other Subscription Agreements and the purposes of the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">It is expressly acknowledged by the Subscriber that the foregoing power of attorney is coupled with an interest and shall survive death or
legal incapacity of the Subscriber, and is irrevocable. Such power of attorney may be exercised by said <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">attorney-in-fact</FONT></FONT> either by signing separately as <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">attorney-in-fact</FONT></FONT> for each of the Investors or by listing all the Investors with a single signature as
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">attorney-in-fact</FONT></FONT> for all of them. Such power of attorney shall survive the termination or dissolution of the Subscriber or the assignment of its interest in the Company;
<U>provided</U>, however, that such power of attorney will so survive only to the extent necessary to enable said <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">attorney-in-fact</FONT></FONT> to effect substitution (if approved by
the Company) of the Subscriber&#8217;s <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">successor-in-interest.</FONT></FONT> The Subscriber hereby waives any and all defenses which may be available to contest, negate or disaffirm
the actions of said <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">attorney-in-fact</FONT></FONT> taken in good faith under such power of attorney. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">- 15 - </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This power of attorney does not supersede the terms of this Subscription Agreement or any
written agreement between the Company and the Subscriber nor is it to be used to deprive the Subscriber of its rights as a Shareholder, and is intended only to provide a simplified system for execution of documents. The Subscriber shall execute and
deliver to the Company, within five days after the receipt of a request therefor, such confirmatory powers of attorney as the Company may request. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">16. <U>Effect of Representations; Survival; Indemnity</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Subscriber understands that the offer and sale of the Shares is being made in reliance on specific exemptions from requirements of federal
and state securities laws and that the Company and the controlling persons thereof, will rely on the representations, warranties, agreements, acknowledgements and understandings of the Subscriber set forth herein in determining the applicability of
such exemptions. The Subscriber hereby confirms that all such representations and warranties will remain true and complete on the date of acceptance by the Company of the Subscriber&#8217;s subscription hereunder. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Subscription Agreement, including all representations and warranties of the Subscriber contained herein, shall survive the sale of the
Shares to the Subscriber, and the admission of the Subscriber as a Shareholder of the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">To the fullest extent permitted under
applicable law, the Subscriber agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Company, the Adviser, the Administrator and their respective affiliates, and each partner, member, shareholder, officer, director, employee and agent thereof, from and against
any loss, damage or liability due to or arising out of a breach of any representation, warranty or agreement of the Subscriber contained in this Subscription Agreement (including the Investor Questionnaire) or in any other document provided by the
Subscriber to the Company or in any agreement executed by the Subscriber in connection with the Subscriber&#8217;s investment in Shares. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">17. <U>Confidentiality</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Subscriber acknowledges that the Memorandum and other information relating to the Company (the &#8220;<U>Confidential
Information</U>&#8221;) have been submitted to the Subscriber on a confidential basis for use solely in connection with the Subscriber&#8217;s consideration of the purchase of Shares. In addition, Confidential Information includes <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> information regarding any other investment vehicles whose investment adviser is the Adviser or an affiliate of the Adviser. Subscriber agrees to comply with all laws, including securities laws, concerning
Confidential Information, and Subscriber agrees that it shall not trade in the securities of any issuer about which Subscriber receives material <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> information under this Subscription Agreement or in
its capacity as a holder of Shares and shall refrain from such trading until any material <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> information no longer constitutes material <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> information.
The Subscriber agrees that, without the prior written consent of the Company (which consent may be withheld at the sole discretion of the Company), the Subscriber shall not (a)&nbsp;reproduce the Memorandum or any other Confidential Information, in
whole or in part, or (b)&nbsp;disclose the Memorandum or any other Confidential Information to any person who is not an officer or employee of the Subscriber who is involved in its investments, or partner (general or limited) or affiliate of the
Subscriber (it being understood and agreed that if the Subscriber is a pooled investment fund, it shall only be permitted to disclose the Memorandum or other Confidential Information if the Subscriber has required its investors to enter into
confidentiality undertakings no less onerous than the provisions of this Section&nbsp;17 and the Subscriber remains liable for any breach of this Section&nbsp;17 by its investors), except to the extent (i)&nbsp;such information is in the public
domain (other than as a result of any action or omission of the Subscriber or any person to whom the Subscriber has disclosed such information) or (ii)&nbsp;such information is required by applicable law or regulation to be disclosed, in which case
the Subscriber shall first notify the Company of such requirement (unless such notification is prohibited by law) so that the Company may pursue a protective order or other appropriate remedy or waive compliance with the terms of this
Section&nbsp;17, and if a protective order or other appropriate remedy is not obtained, or if the Company waives compliance with the terms of this Section&nbsp;17, then the Subscriber shall disclose only that portion of Confidential Information that
the Subscriber is advised by counsel is legally required to be disclosed and shall use its commercially reasonable efforts to protect the confidentiality of such information disclosed, including by requesting that confidential treatment be accorded
such information. The Subscriber further agrees to return the Memorandum and any other information relating to the Company upon the Company&#8217;s request therefor. The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees that monetary damages would not be
sufficient remedy for any breach of this Section&nbsp;17 by the Subscriber and that, in addition to any other remedies available to the Company in respect of any such breach, the Company shall be entitled to specific performance and injunctive or
other equitable relief as a remedy for any such breach. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>II. Accredited Investor Status </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Subscriber represents and warrants that it is an &#8220;accredited investor&#8221; within the meaning of Regulation D under the U.S.
Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Securities Act</U>&#8221;), and has indicated below each category under which the Subscriber qualifies as an accredited investor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Subscriber is: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A bank, as defined in Section&nbsp;3(a)(2) of the Securities Act, whether acting in regard to this offering in
its individual or a fiduciary capacity. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

acting in regard to this offering in its individual or a fiduciary capacity. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">1</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">For the purposes of calculating joint net worth in this subsection, joint net worth can be the aggregate net
worth of the Subscriber and spouse or spousal equivalent, and assets need not be held jointly to be included in the calculation </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">2</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">For this purpose, a &#8220;spousal equivalent&#8221; means a cohabitant occupying a relationship generally
equivalent to that of a spouse. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">3</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">For purposes of this net worth calculation, the Subscriber may exclude the amount of indebtedness secured by
the Subscriber&#8217;s primary residence up to the amount of the value of such residence. However, if the amount of the indebtedness secured by the Subscriber&#8217;s primary residence exceeds the value of such residence, the amount of that excess
debt should be treated as a liability and deducted from the Subscriber&#8217;s net worth. In addition, indebtedness secured by the Subscriber&#8217;s primary residence that is incurred within sixty (60)&nbsp;days of the date of the subscription made
hereby must be included as a liability unless such indebtedness is incurred in connection with the acquisition of the Subscriber&#8217;s primary residence. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

accredited investor status of entities under this subsection. If relying on this subsection, the Subscriber agrees to provide to the Company any information regarding the Subscriber&#8217;s direct and indirect equity owners in order for the Company
to determine whether or not such equity owners are accredited investors </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

defined in Section&nbsp;2(a) of the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as amended (the &#8220;BHC Act&#8221;), a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-bank</FONT> subsidiary (for purposes of the BHC Act) of a bank holding company, a foreign banking
organization, as defined in Regulation K of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (12 C.F.R. &#167; 211.23) or any successor regulation, or a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-bank</FONT> subsidiary (for purposes of the BHC Act) of
a foreign banking organization which subsidiary is engaged, directly or indirectly in business in the United States and which in any case holds Shares for its own account. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>IV. Dividend Reinvestment Plan. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Pursuant
to the Company&#8217;s dividend reinvestment plan, cash distributions to investors are automatically reinvested for additional Shares. Subscribers may opt in or opt out of the plan by checking the appropriate box below. Elections may be altered,
subject to approval by the Company, by notifying the Company in writing at 500 Park Avenue, 3<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">rd</SUP> Floor, New York, NY 10022, Attention: Investor Relations. A change in election must be received by
the Company at least ten calendar days prior to any distribution date; otherwise, such election shall be effective only with respect to any subsequent distributions. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If neither box is checked, Subscriber will be automatically enrolled in the Company&#8217;s dividend reinvestment plan. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#9744; <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Opt-out</FONT> of the Dividend Reinvestment Plan to receive cash distributions </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#9744; <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Opt-in</FONT> to the Dividend Reinvestment Plan to reinvest distributions for additional Shares </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">A-6 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>APPENDIX F </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PRIVACY POLICY </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SLR
Secured Specialty Lending Fund, a Delaware statutory trust (the &#8220;<B><I>Fund</I></B>,&#8221; &#8220;<B><I>we</I></B>,&#8221; &#8220;<B><I>us</I></B>&#8221; or &#8220;<B><I>our</I></B>&#8221;) considers privacy to be a fundamental part of our
relationship with the recordholders of our common shares who are natural persons (&#8220;<B><I>recordholders</I></B>&#8221;). We are committed to protecting the privacy of our recordholders&#8217; Nonpublic Personal Information (defined below).
Accordingly, we have developed internal policies to protect confidentiality, while allowing our business and investment program to be conducted in an appropriate and efficient manner. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">These policies apply to current and former recordholders, and govern the conduct of officers and other personnel, if any, of us and our
affiliates who provide services to us (including employees, contractors and temporary workers). These policies therefore apply to SLR Secured Lending Partners, LLC (the &#8220;<B><I>Investment Adviser</I></B>&#8221;) and personnel and affiliates of
the Investment Adviser who provide services to the Investment Adviser (including employees, contractors and temporary workers). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Our Chief
Compliance Officer (&#8220;<B><I>CCO</I></B>&#8221;) will have responsibility for monitoring compliance with our Privacy Policy. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Definitions
</I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-P</FONT> (&#8220;<B><I>Reg <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-P</FONT></I></B>&#8221;) requires
registered investment advisers to develop, implement, and maintain written policies and procedures that address administrative, technical, and physical safeguards for the protection of Customer Information, Sensitive Customer Information and
Consumer Information, as defined by Reg <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-P.</FONT> Such policies and procedures must be reasonably designed to: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Ensure the security and confidentiality of Customer Information;</P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Protect against any anticipated threats or hazards to the security or integrity of Customer Information;
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

inconvenience to any Customer;</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Detect, respond to, and recover from unauthorized access to or use of Customer Information, including Customer
notification procedures. This response program must include procedures to:</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Assess the nature and scope of any incident involving unauthorized access to or use of Customer Information and
identify the Customer Information Systems and types of Customer Information that may have been accessed or used without authorization; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Take appropriate steps to contain and control the incident to prevent further unauthorized access to or use of
Customer Information; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Within 30 days of becoming so aware, notify each affected individual whose Sensitive Customer Information was, or
is reasonably likely to have been, accessed or used without authorization unless the investment adviser determines, after a reasonable investigation of the facts and circumstances of the incident of unauthorized access to or use of Sensitive
Customer Information, that the Sensitive Customer Information has not been, and is not reasonably likely to be, used in a manner that would result in substantial harm or inconvenience. The notification must include a description of the incident, the
type of information breached, the date of the breach, contact information, recommended actions for the Customer, and guidance from the Federal Trade Commission. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

the investment adviser notifies affected individuals as set forth above. Such policies and procedures must be reasonably designed to ensure Service Providers take appropriate measures to:</P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="14%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Types of information that could be used to gain access to a Customer&#8217;s account; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="14%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Telecommunication identifying information or access device; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="10%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Customer Information identifying an individual or the individual&#8217;s account, including the
individual&#8217;s account number, name or online user name, in combination with authenticating information, or in combination with similar information that could be used to gain access to the Customer&#8217;s account such as an access code, a
credit card expiration date, a partial Social Security number, a security code, a security question and answer identified with the individual or the individual&#8217;s account, or the individual&#8217;s date of birth, place of birth, or
mother&#8217;s maiden name. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">&#8220;Consumer Information&#8221; means any record about an individual that is a consumer report or is derived
from a consumer report, or a compilation of such records, that an investment adviser maintains or otherwise possesses for a business purpose but does not include information that does not identify individuals, such as aggregate information or blind
data.</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">&#8220;Service Provider&#8221; means the Investment Adviser, Administrator, accountants, attorneys, custodians,
transfer agent, underwriters, proxy solicitors and any other third party provider. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">To understand the difference between Reg <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-P&#8217;s</FONT> four types of &#8220;Information&#8221; it is important to note the following: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Most information protected under Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-P</FONT> is Nonpublic Personal
Information;</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Nonpublic Personal Information includes information of and about Customers and prospective Customers.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Customer Information and Sensitive Customer Information are just two different types of Nonpublic Personal
Information that only pertain to Customers (i.e. not prospective Customers) to which Reg <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-P</FONT> attaches specific requirements that do not apply to general Nonpublic Personal Information. Sensitive Customer
Information is itself, a specific type of Customer Information to which different requirements are attached that do not apply to general Customer Information. Thus, any reference to Nonpublic Personal Information refers also to Customer Information
and Sensitive Customer Information&nbsp;(but not vice versa), and any reference to Customer Information refers also to Sensitive Customer Information (but not vice versa). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">While most Consumer Information will likely also be Nonpublic Personal Information, it could also contain
information that is not Nonpublic Personal Information. The concept of Consumer Information is only relevant to one provision in this policy. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">F-3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Collection of Information </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Generally, we will not receive any Nonpublic Personal Information about recordholders of the common shares of the Fund, although certain of our
recordholders&#8217; Nonpublic Personal Information may become available to us. The Nonpublic Personal Information that we may receive falls into the following categories: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="14%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Information we receive from recordholders, whether we receive it orally, in writing or electronically. This
includes recordholders&#8217; communications to us concerning their investments; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="14%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Information about recordholders&#8217; transactions and history with us; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="14%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Other general information that we may obtain about recordholders, such as demographic and contact information
such as address. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Disclosure of Information </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We do not disclose any Nonpublic Personal Information about recordholders, except: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="10%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">to our affiliates (such as the Investment Adviser and SLR Capital Management, LLC (the
&#8220;<B><I>Administrator</I></B>&#8221;)) and their employees for everyday business purposes; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="10%">&nbsp;</TD>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">to our Service Providers (such as our accountants, attorneys, custodians, transfer agent, underwriters and proxy
solicitors) and their employees as is necessary to service recordholder accounts or otherwise provide the applicable service; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">to comply with court orders, subpoenas, lawful discovery requests, or other legal or regulatory requirements; or
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
